metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels over Shanghai increase between February 10-25, 2020 and April 20-May 12, 2020?

data.raw_code: The question is about comparing mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide (NO₂) levels over Shanghai between two time periods: 1. February 10-25, 2020 2. April 20-May 12, 2020 For NO₂ data, I should use the Sentinel-5P TROPOMI instrument, which provides tropospheric NO₂ data. The relevant band is 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'. Strategy: 1. Define Shanghai geometry (using a point or polygon around Shanghai) 2. Get Sentinel-5P NO₂ data for both periods 3. Calculate mean NO₂ for each period 4. Compare the values to see if there was an increase Data quality considerations: - Check if collections have data - Check if there are valid pixels after processing - Validate the calculated values are reasonable (NO₂ values should be positive, typically in the range of 0-1000 μmol/m²) I'll need to handle potential missing data and validate the results. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const shanghai = ee.Geometry.Point([121.4737, 31.2304]).buffer(50000); // Shanghai center with 50km buffer // Time periods const period1_start = '2020-02-10'; const period1_end = '2020-02-25'; const period2_start = '2020-04-20'; const period2_end = '2020-05-12'; // 2. Data Acquisition const no2_col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(period1_start, period1_end) .filterBounds(shanghai) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); const no2_col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(period2_start, period2_end) .filterBounds(shanghai) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); // Check collection sizes const size1 = no2_col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = no2_col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1 (Feb 10-25): ${size1} images`); console.log(`Period 2 (Apr 20-May 12): ${size2} images`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Create mean composites const mean1 = no2_col1.mean(); const mean2 = no2_col2.mean(); // 3. Processing - Check valid pixels const count1 = mean1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: shanghai, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); const count2 = mean2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: shanghai, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels - Period 1: ${count1}, Period 2: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean NO2 values const mean_no2_1 = mean1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: shanghai, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); const mean_no2_2 = mean2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: shanghai, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); console.log(`Mean NO2 - Period 1: ${mean_no2_1?.toFixed(6)} mol/m²`); console.log(`Mean NO2 - Period 2: ${mean_no2_2?.toFixed(6)} mol/m²`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (mean_no2_1 === null || mean_no2_2 === null || isNaN(mean_no2_1) || isNaN(mean_no2_2) || mean_no2_1 < 0 || mean_no2_2 < 0) { console.log("C3"); } else if (mean_no2_2 > mean_no2_1) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
